name: borongan-roadwatch-workspace
description: Borongan Road Damage Reporting and Maintenance System (Web GIS Dashboard & Mobile App)

scripts.build: npm --prefix pixel-perfect-main install && npm --prefix pixel-perfect-main run build && node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('pixel-perfect-main/.vercel')) fs.cpSync('pixel-perfect-main/.vercel', '.vercel', {recursive: true});"
scripts.install:all: npm --prefix pixel-perfect-main install && npm --prefix mobile install
